method: NAIVE. Written straight from the deposited text using only the writing-l4-rules skill. No pipeline, no coverage table, no probe record, no independent test pass, no human gate. One pass, no review.
edition_encoded: Variable Capital Companies Act 2018 (Singapore), 2020 Revised Edition, informal consolidation, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/ (amendments to Act 24 of 2025).

checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: SCOPED to what distinguishes a VCC and what a director or member can be liable for, one module. s 15 (sole object), ss 17, 17A and 18 (members, minimum, duty to refuse registration), s 29 (sub-fund segregation), s 35 (redemption), s 46 (manager), s 48 (directors, resignation, members' liability for debts), s 53(7) and (8) (removal direction effective pending appeal), s 58 (disqualification on conviction). Not encoded: ss 5 to 6A (application of the Companies Act and IRDA), Part 2, the rest of Parts 3 to 6, sub-fund winding up and dissolution, debentures and charges, meetings, accounts and audit, winding up, foreign VCCs, offences machinery, and the regulations.
